title: The first step up to manager
description: Women in the Workplace 2025, using calendar-year 2024 promotions: normalized to 100 men promoted to manager, the report shows 93 women overall, 82 Asian women, 82 Latinas, and 60 Black women. These groups overlap: women overall includes the displayed subgroups. These are promotion-rate ratios, not percentages of all promotions.
